stages.name: parameters

SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text","name",NULL AS "annotation",NULL AS "position" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_id AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=CASE WHEN p.kind='identifier' THEN p.id ELSE (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=p.__path AND child.parent=p.id AND child.ordinal=0 AND child.kind='identifier' LIMIT 1) END
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter'))

stages.name: decorator_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","decorator",NULL AS "node","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,decorator,node) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,d.id,x.id FROM declarations f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,c.callee_id FROM walk w JOIN calls c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.node)
        SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,w.node,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: expression_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","expression",NULL AS "id","name","through_call" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE root(__path,expression,node,through_call) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,0 FROM nodes UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,r.expression,c.id,r.through_call OR n.kind='call' FROM root r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.node JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=CASE WHEN n.kind='attribute' THEN n.object_id WHEN n.kind='subscript' THEN n.value_id WHEN n.kind='call' THEN n.function_id WHEN n.kind IN ('parenthesized_expression','type') THEN (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id AND child.ordinal=0 LIMIT 1) END) SELECT r.__path,r.expression,n.id,n.text name,r.through_call FROM root r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.node WHERE n.kind='identifier')

stages.name: bound_names
stages.query: SELECT "__path","assignment",NULL AS "id","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE bound(__path,assignment,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,target FROM assignments UNION ALL SELECT b.__path,b.assignment,c.id FROM bound b JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.id=b.node JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('tuple','list','pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern')) SELECT b.__path,b.assignment,n.id,n.text name FROM bound b JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.id=b.node WHERE n.kind='identifier')

stages.name: call_edges
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","caller","target" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,o.fn caller,t.id target FROM calls c JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id JOIN declaration_contexts owner ON owner.__path=o.__path AND owner.id=o.fn JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=c.__path AND root.expression=c.callee_id JOIN declaration_contexts t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.kind='function_definition' AND t.name=c.callee
        WHERE (c.callee_kind='identifier' AND (t.lexical_parent IS NULL OR t.lexical_parent=owner.lexical_parent) OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND root.name IN ('self','cls') AND t.lexical_parent=owner.lexical_parent)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=c.__path AND n.kind='lambda' AND n.__start<c.__start AND n.__end>=c.__end)
        AND (root.name IN ('self','cls') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=o.fn AND p.name=root.name) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=o.fn AND b.name=root.name)))

stages.name: file_modules
stages.query: SELECT "__path","module" FROM (SELECT __path,replace(CASE WHEN __path GLOB '*/__init__.py' THEN substr(__path,1,length(__path)-12) ELSE substr(__path,1,length(__path)-3) END,'/','.') module FROM nodes WHERE kind='module')

stages.name: call_imports
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","import_kind","local","target" FROM (SELECT n.__path,own.fn,n.kind import_kind,coalesce(x.alias_source,x.name_source,x.text) local,CASE WHEN substr(n.module_name_source,1,1)='.' THEN rx_replace(m.module||CASE WHEN n.__path GLOB '*/__init__.py' THEN '.__init__' ELSE '' END,'(?:\.[^.]+){'||length(rx_extract(n.module_name_source,'^\.*',0))||'}$','')||'.'||rx_replace(n.module_name_source,'^\.+','') ELSE n.module_name_source END||'.'||coalesce(x.name_source,x.text) target FROM nodes n JOIN file_modules m ON m.__path=n.__path JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id AND x.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND x.id IS NOT n.module_name_id WHERE n.kind='import_from_statement' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,own.fn,n.kind import_kind,coalesce(x.alias_source,rx_extract(coalesce(x.name_source,x.text),'^[^.]+',0)),coalesce(x.name_source,x.text) FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id AND x.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') WHERE n.kind='import_statement')

stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","qualified" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,m.module||'.'||f.qualname qualified FROM declaration_contexts f JOIN file_modules m ON m.__path=f.__path WHERE f.kind='function_definition')

stages.name: purity_call_edges
stages.query: SELECT "__path","caller","target_path","target" FROM (SELECT e.__path,e.caller,e.__path target_path,e.target FROM call_edges e UNION SELECT c.__path,o.fn,t.__path,t.id FROM calls c JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver JOIN call_imports imp ON imp.__path=c.__path AND imp.local=CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='identifier' THEN c.callee ELSE receiver.text END AND (imp.fn IS NULL OR imp.fn=o.fn) JOIN qualified_functions t ON t.qualified=imp.target||CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' THEN '.'||c.callee ELSE '' END WHERE (c.callee_kind='identifier' OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=o.fn AND p.name=imp.local) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=o.fn AND b.name=imp.local) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=c.__path AND n.kind='lambda' AND n.__start<c.__start AND n.__end>=c.__end) AND NOT(imp.fn IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM call_imports local WHERE local.__path=imp.__path AND local.fn=o.fn AND local.local=imp.local)))

stages.name: function_flags
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_start",NULL AS "attribute_end",NULL AS "attribute_kind",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id","body_start","body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","return_type_id","return_type_start","return_type_end","return_type_kind","alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","explicit","legacy","surface" FROM (SELECT f.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name IN ('pure_lazy','lazy')) explicit,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name IN ('legacy_sync','legacy_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_module_async')) legacy,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ownership o JOIN classes c ON c.__path=o.__path AND c.id=o.cls JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=c.__path JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=a.__path AND parent.id=a.parent WHERE o.__path=f.__path AND o.id=f.id AND a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.target_text='__pure_lazy_surface__' AND a.expr_kind='true' AND parent.parent=c.body_id) surface
        FROM declaration_contexts f WHERE f.kind='function_definition' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declaration_contexts later WHERE later.__path=f.__path AND later.qualname=f.qualname AND later.kind='function_definition' AND later.__start>f.__start))

stages.name: direct_colored_functions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id",NULL AS "color" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE colored(__path,id,color) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,'pure' FROM function_flags WHERE explicit
        UNION SELECT f.__path,f.id,'owner' FROM function_flags f WHERE f.name GLOB '*_lazy' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name IN ('conn','connection','owner','session','tx','txn')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end AND c.callee IN ('ddl_effect_lazy','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_value_lazy')) UNION SELECT e.target_path,e.target,c.color FROM colored c JOIN purity_call_edges e ON e.__path=c.__path AND e.caller=c.id JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=e.target_path AND f.id=e.target WHERE NOT f.legacy) SELECT __path,id,max(color) color FROM colored GROUP BY __path,id)

stages.name: admitted_files
stages.query:
SELECT "__path" FROM (SELECT __path FROM direct_colored_functions
        UNION SELECT __path FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND rx_matches(text,'pure_lazy|__pure_lazy_surface__|_lazy')
        UNION SELECT __path FROM declarations WHERE name IN ('create_embedding_ref_class','create_embedding_vector_class','register_permissions','register_table'))

stages.name: class_catalog
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id",NULL AS "qualname","qualified","class_key" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id,c.qualname,m.module||'.'||c.qualname qualified,
        row_number() OVER(ORDER BY c.__path,c.id) class_key
        FROM declaration_contexts c JOIN file_modules m ON m.__path=c.__path WHERE c.kind='class_definition'
        AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admitted_files a WHERE a.__path=c.__path) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admitted_files)))

stages.name: class_bases
stages.query:
SELECT "child_key","parent_key","ordinal" FROM (SELECT child.class_key child_key,parent.class_key parent_key,base.ordinal
        FROM class_catalog child JOIN file_modules module ON module.__path=child.__path
        JOIN nodes args ON args.__path=child.__path AND args.parent=child.id AND args.kind='argument_list'
        JOIN nodes base ON base.__path=args.__path AND base.parent=args.id AND base.kind IN ('identifier','attribute')
        JOIN class_catalog parent ON parent.qualified=CASE WHEN base.kind='identifier' THEN
          coalesce((SELECT imp.target FROM call_imports imp WHERE imp.__path=child.__path AND imp.fn IS NULL AND imp.local=base.text AND imp.import_kind='import_from_statement'),module.module||'.'||base.text)
        ELSE coalesce((SELECT imp.target||'.'||base.attribute_source FROM call_imports imp WHERE imp.__path=child.__path AND imp.fn IS NULL AND imp.local=base.object_source AND imp.import_kind='import_statement'),rx_replace(base.text,'\s+','')) END)

stages.name: method_demands
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","caller","call","name","class_key" FROM (SELECT c.__path,o.fn caller,c.id call,c.callee name,cls.class_key
        FROM calls c JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id
        JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn
        JOIN class_catalog cls ON cls.__path=f.__path AND cls.id=f.lexical_parent
        LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver
        WHERE c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end
        AND (c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text IN ('self','cls')
          OR c.callee_kind='identifier'
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_flags global WHERE global.__path=c.__path AND global.lexical_parent IS NULL AND global.name=c.callee)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM call_imports imp WHERE imp.__path=c.__path AND imp.local=c.callee AND (imp.fn IS NULL OR imp.fn=f.id))
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=c.callee)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=f.id AND b.name=c.callee))
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=c.__path AND n.kind='lambda' AND n.__start<c.__start AND n.__end>=c.__end))

stages.name: inherited_edges
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","caller","target_path","target" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE search(__path,caller,call,name,class_key,route,seen) AS (
        SELECT __path,caller,call,name,class_key,'',','||class_key||',' FROM method_demands
        UNION ALL SELECT s.__path,s.caller,s.call,s.name,b.parent_key,s.route||printf('%08d',b.ordinal),s.seen||b.parent_key||','
        FROM search s JOIN class_bases b ON b.child_key=s.class_key
        WHERE instr(s.seen,','||b.parent_key||',')=0 AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM class_catalog cls JOIN function_flags own ON own.__path=cls.__path AND own.lexical_parent=cls.id
          WHERE cls.class_key=s.class_key AND own.name=s.name))
        SELECT __path,caller,target_path,target FROM (
          SELECT s.__path,s.caller,s.call,f.__path target_path,f.id target,
            row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY s.__path,s.call ORDER BY s.route) chosen
          FROM search s JOIN class_catalog cls ON cls.class_key=s.class_key
          JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=cls.__path AND f.lexical_parent=cls.id AND f.name=s.name)
        WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: complete_purity_edges
stages.query: SELECT "__path","caller","target_path","target" FROM (SELECT * FROM purity_call_edges UNION SELECT * FROM inherited_edges)

stages.name: colored_functions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","color" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE colored(__path,id,color) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,'pure' FROM function_flags WHERE explicit
        UNION SELECT f.__path,f.id,'owner' FROM function_flags f WHERE f.name GLOB '*_lazy' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name IN ('conn','connection','owner','session','tx','txn')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end AND c.callee IN ('ddl_effect_lazy','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_value_lazy')) UNION SELECT e.target_path,e.target,c.color FROM colored c JOIN complete_purity_edges e ON e.__path=c.__path AND e.caller=c.id JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=e.target_path AND f.id=e.target WHERE NOT f.legacy) SELECT __path,id,max(color) color FROM colored GROUP BY __path,id)

stages.name: return_contracts
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE annotation(__path,fn,id) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,return_type_id FROM functions WHERE return_type_start IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,n.id FROM annotation a JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=a.__path AND parent.id=a.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.parent=a.id
        WHERE NOT (parent.kind IN ('generic_type','subscript') AND rx_matches(parent.text,'^(?:type|Type)\s*\[')))
        SELECT DISTINCT a.__path,a.fn id FROM annotation a JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.id=a.id
        WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND coalesce(n.attribute_source,n.text) IN ('BatchContext','ReadTransaction','SyncDatabaseConnection','SyncSqlConnection','WriteTransaction'))

stages.name: passthrough
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","value" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id,coalesce(a.id,c.id) value FROM calls c LEFT JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee='cast' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM arguments x WHERE x.__path=c.__path AND x.call=c.id)=2)

stages.name: module_bindings
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id","right_start","right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_start",NULL AS "attribute_end",NULL AS "attribute_kind",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","return_type_id","return_type_start","return_type_end","return_type_kind","alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","target","target_kind","target_text","value","expr_kind","expr_text","fn","name" FROM (SELECT a.*,b.name FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id JOIN nodes e ON e.__path=a.__path AND e.id=a.parent JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=e.__path AND parent.id=e.parent WHERE e.kind='expression_statement' AND parent.kind='module')

stages.name: binding_values
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","binding","value","kind" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE value(__path,binding,node) AS (
      SELECT __path,id,value FROM module_bindings WHERE value IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL SELECT v.__path,v.binding,child.id FROM value v JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=v.__path AND n.id=v.node JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id AND child.ordinal=0 WHERE n.kind='parenthesized_expression')
      SELECT v.__path,v.binding,n.id value,n.kind FROM value v JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=v.__path AND n.id=v.node WHERE n.kind!='parenthesized_expression')

stages.name: contextvars
stages.query: SELECT "__path","name" FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.name FROM module_bindings a JOIN binding_values v ON v.__path=a.__path AND v.binding=a.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=v.__path AND c.id=v.value WHERE c.callee='ContextVar')

stages.name: runtime_sources
stages.query:
SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE runtime(__path,id,name) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.name FROM functions f JOIN return_contracts r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.id=f.id
        UNION SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.name FROM functions f JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.fn=f.id LEFT JOIN passthrough pass ON pass.__path=r.__path AND pass.id=r.value JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=coalesce(pass.value,r.value) JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=c.__path AND root.expression=c.callee_id JOIN contextvars v ON v.__path=root.__path AND v.name=root.name WHERE c.callee='get'
        UNION SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.name FROM functions f JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value JOIN runtime old ON old.__path=c.__path AND old.name=c.callee) SELECT * FROM runtime)

stages.name: runtime_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM calls c JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=c.__path AND root.expression=c.callee_id WHERE c.callee='get' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contextvars v WHERE v.__path=c.__path AND v.name=root.name) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_sources h WHERE h.__path=c.__path AND h.name=c.callee AND (c.callee_kind='identifier' OR root.name IN ('self','cls'))))

stages.name: opaque_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","payload_field" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.id,coalesce((SELECT field.name FROM keywords k JOIN calls payload ON payload.__path=k.__path AND payload.id=k.value JOIN keywords field ON field.__path=payload.__path AND field.call=payload.id WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='payload' AND field.name IN ('conn','connection','context','fn','handle','tx','txn') ORDER BY field.__start LIMIT 1),'handle') payload_field FROM calls c WHERE c.callee IN ('_queue_handle_entry_lazy') OR c.callee='LazyOperation' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k JOIN calls payload ON payload.__path=k.__path AND payload.id=k.value JOIN keywords field ON field.__path=payload.__path AND field.call=payload.id WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='payload' AND field.name IN ('conn','connection','context','fn','handle','tx','txn')))

stages.name: opaque_locals
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name","since","payload_field" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE opaque_local(__path,fn,name,since,payload_field) AS (
        SELECT a.__path,a.fn,b.name,a.__start,o.payload_field FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id LEFT JOIN passthrough pass ON pass.__path=a.__path AND pass.id=a.value JOIN opaque_calls o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.id=coalesce(pass.value,a.value)
        UNION SELECT a.__path,a.fn,b.name,a.__start,old.payload_field FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id JOIN opaque_local old ON old.__path=a.__path AND old.fn=a.fn AND old.name=a.expr_text AND old.since<a.__start WHERE a.expr_kind='identifier') SELECT * FROM opaque_local)

stages.name: opaque_values
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","payload_field" FROM (SELECT __path,id,payload_field FROM opaque_calls UNION SELECT n.__path,n.id,o.payload_field FROM nodes n JOIN ownership owner ON owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=n.id JOIN opaque_locals o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.fn=owner.fn AND o.name=n.text AND o.since<n.__start WHERE n.kind='identifier' UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id,o.payload_field FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 JOIN opaque_locals o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.name=a.text AND o.since<c.__start JOIN ownership owner ON owner.__path=c.__path AND owner.id=c.id AND owner.fn=o.fn WHERE c.callee IN ('queue_single','queue_sequence') AND a.kind='identifier')

stages.name: tainted_locals
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name","since" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE taint(__path,fn,name,since) AS (
        SELECT a.__path,f.id,b.name,a.__start FROM active_functions f JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.__end<=f.body_end JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes attr JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=attr.__path AND root.expression=attr.object JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=root.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=root.name WHERE attr.__path=a.__path AND attr.__start>=a.right_start AND attr.__end<=a.right_end AND attr.attr IN ('_base_txn','_conn','_cursor','_read_txn','_schema_txn','_session','_sql_conn','_transaction','_tx','_txn','_write_txn') AND NOT (f.surface AND root.name='self')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c JOIN arguments first ON first.__path=c.__path AND first.call=c.id AND first.position=0 JOIN arguments second ON second.__path=c.__path AND second.call=c.id AND second.position=1 JOIN strings s ON s.__path=second.__path AND s.__start=second.__start JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=first.__path AND root.expression=first.id JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=root.name WHERE c.__path=a.__path AND c.id=a.value AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee='getattr' AND s.value IN ('_base_txn','_conn','_cursor','_read_txn','_schema_txn','_session','_sql_conn','_transaction','_tx','_txn','_write_txn') AND NOT(f.surface AND root.name='self')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_calls r WHERE r.__path=a.__path AND r.id=a.value) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM opaque_values r WHERE r.__path=a.__path AND r.id=a.value)
 UNION SELECT a.__path,f.id,b.name,a.__start FROM taint t JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=t.__path AND f.id=t.fn JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.__end<=f.body_end AND a.__start>t.since JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.__start>=a.right_start AND n.__end<=a.right_end AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=t.name) SELECT * FROM taint)

stages.name: protected_accesses
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end",NULL AS "detail","through_call" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,a.id,a.__start,a.__end,a.attr detail,r.through_call FROM active_functions f JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.__end<=f.body_end JOIN expression_roots r ON r.__path=a.__path AND r.expression=a.object WHERE a.attr IN ('_base_txn','_conn','_cursor','_read_txn','_schema_txn','_session','_sql_conn','_transaction','_tx','_txn','_write_txn') AND NOT (f.surface AND r.name='self') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=r.name) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tainted_locals t WHERE t.__path=f.__path AND t.fn=f.id AND t.name=r.name AND t.since<a.__start)))

stages.name: dynamic_accesses
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","detail" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,s.value detail FROM active_functions f JOIN calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end JOIN arguments first ON first.__path=c.__path AND first.call=c.id AND first.position=0 JOIN arguments second ON second.__path=c.__path AND second.call=c.id AND second.position=1 JOIN strings s ON s.__path=second.__path AND s.__start=second.__start JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=first.__path AND root.expression=first.id WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee='getattr' AND s.value IN ('_base_txn','_conn','_cursor','_read_txn','_schema_txn','_session','_sql_conn','_transaction','_tx','_txn','_write_txn') AND (f.strict OR NOT (f.surface AND root.name='self') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=root.name) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tainted_locals t WHERE t.__path=f.__path AND t.fn=f.id AND t.name=root.name AND t.since<c.__start))))

stages.name: frozen_classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM classes c JOIN decorator_names d ON d.__path=c.__path AND d.fn=c.id JOIN calls call ON call.__path=d.__path AND call.parent=d.decorator JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=call.__path AND k.call=call.id WHERE d.name='dataclass' AND k.name='frozen' AND k.kind='true')

stages.name: global_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_start",NULL AS "attribute_end",NULL AS "attribute_kind",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","return_type_id","return_type_start","return_type_end","return_type_kind","alias_id","alias_source","module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","callee_id","callee_kind","full_callee","callee","receiver","managed" FROM (SELECT c.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='name') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='register_with_manager' AND k.kind='false') AND (c.callee='ObjectCache' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='max_entries' AND k.kind!='none') OR c.callee IN ('LocalMetadataCache','WeakLocalMetadataCache') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND (k.name='max_entries' AND k.kind!='none' OR k.name='invalidation_policy' AND k.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND coalesce((SELECT a.attr FROM attributes a WHERE a.__path=k.__path AND a.id=k.value),k.text)!='MANUAL')) OR c.callee='IdentityTokenCache' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='max_strong_entries' AND k.kind!='none') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=k.__path AND a.id=k.value WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='invalidation_policy' AND a.attr='BOUNDED_IDENTITY_TOKENS')) managed FROM calls c)

stages.name: mutated_globals
stages.query: SELECT "__path","name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.__path,b.name FROM module_bindings b JOIN calls c ON c.__path=b.__path JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=c.__path AND r.id=c.receiver WHERE c.callee IN ('add','append','clear','discard','extend','pop','popitem','remove','set','setdefault','update') AND r.kind='identifier' AND r.text=b.name UNION SELECT DISTINCT b.__path,b.name FROM module_bindings b JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=b.__path JOIN nodes target ON target.__path=a.__path AND target.id=a.target JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=target.__path AND root.expression=target.id WHERE target.kind IN ('subscript','attribute') AND root.name=b.name)

stages.name: global_state
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","name","category","mutable","managed" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE referenced_names(__path,name) AS (
      SELECT used.__path,used.text FROM nodes used
      CROSS JOIN module_bindings a ON a.__path=used.__path AND a.name=used.text
      CROSS JOIN binding_values v ON v.__path=a.__path AND v.binding=a.id
      CROSS JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=v.__path AND value.id=v.value
      WHERE used.kind='identifier' AND value.kind IN ('dictionary','list','set')
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_functions f WHERE f.__path=used.__path AND used.__start>=f.body_start AND used.__end<=f.body_end)
      GROUP BY used.__path,used.text),
      immutable_walk(__path,binding,root,node) AS (
      SELECT a.__path,a.id,v.value,v.value FROM module_bindings a JOIN binding_values v ON v.__path=a.__path AND v.binding=a.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=v.__path AND n.id=v.value WHERE n.kind IN ('dictionary','list','set') AND (a.__path,a.name) IN (SELECT __path,name FROM referenced_names)
      UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.binding,w.root,child.id FROM immutable_walk w
      JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node AND (n.id=w.root OR n.kind IN ('pair','tuple','unary_operator','binary_operator','parenthesized_expression'))
      JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id WHERE child.kind!='comment'
      UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.binding,w.root,child.id FROM immutable_walk w
      JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node AND n.kind='call'
      JOIN calls c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=n.id AND c.callee IN ('MappingProxyType','frozenset','tuple') AND c.callee NOT IN ('tuple','frozenset')
      JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=n.__path AND child.id IN (SELECT a.id FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id) WHERE child.kind!='comment'),
      static_lookups AS (SELECT w.__path,w.binding FROM immutable_walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN calls c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=n.id
        GROUP BY w.__path,w.binding HAVING sum(CASE WHEN n.id=w.root OR n.kind IN ('pair','tuple','unary_operator','binary_operator','parenthesized_expression','integer','float','true','false','none','ellipsis','concatenated_string') OR n.kind='string' AND NOT rx_matches(n.text,'(?i)^[rbu]*f') OR n.kind='call' AND c.callee IN ('MappingProxyType','frozenset','tuple') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)=0 AND count(*)>1)
      SELECT a.__path,a.name,CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN c.managed THEN 'managed-memoization-cache' ELSE 'runtime-object' END WHEN m.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'mutated-cache-or-registry' WHEN static.binding IS NOT NULL THEN 'mutable-static-table' ELSE 'mutable-cache-or-registry' END category,CASE WHEN m.name IS NOT NULL OR v.kind IN ('dictionary','dictionary_comprehension','list','list_comprehension','set','set_comprehension','generator_expression') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mutable,coalesce(c.managed,0) managed FROM module_bindings a LEFT JOIN binding_values v ON v.__path=a.__path AND v.binding=a.id LEFT JOIN global_calls c ON c.__path=v.__path AND c.id=v.value LEFT JOIN mutated_globals m ON m.__path=a.__path AND m.name=a.name LEFT JOIN static_lookups static ON static.__path=a.__path AND static.binding=a.id WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL OR v.kind IN ('dictionary','dictionary_comprehension','list','list_comprehension','set','set_comprehension','generator_expression') OR c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.callee NOT IN ('MappingProxyType','NewType','ParamSpec','TypeVar','TypeVarTuple','frozenset','load_python_module','tuple') AND NOT (c.callee='compile' AND rx_matches(c.full_callee,'^(?:re|_re)\.') OR c.callee='getLogger' AND c.callee_kind='attribute') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM frozen_classes f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.name=c.callee))

stages.name: global_uses
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","name","mutable",NULL AS "managed" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.text name,g.mutable,g.managed FROM global_state g JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=g.__path AND root.name=g.name JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=root.__path AND n.id=root.expression AND n.kind='identifier' JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=n.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT coalesce((parent.kind IN ('attribute','keyword_argument','function_definition','class_definition','default_parameter','typed_parameter','typed_default_parameter') AND n.id=parent.name_id OR parent.kind='attribute' AND n.id=parent.attribute_id),0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=n.text) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id AND b.name=n.text))

stages.name: global_receivers
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","name",NULL AS "mutable","managed" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,n.id,g.name,g.mutable,g.managed FROM global_state g JOIN expression_roots r ON r.__path=g.__path AND r.name=g.name AND NOT r.through_call JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.expression JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=n.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end WHERE 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name=g.name) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN bound_names b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.assignment=a.id WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id AND b.name=g.name))

stages.name: return_events
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","issue","detail","allowed" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,r.id,r.__start,r.__end,
        CASE WHEN allowed.id IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN opaque.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PLP-010' WHEN dynamic.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PLP-002'
        WHEN contract.id IS NOT NULL AND runtime.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PLP-003'
        WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM protected_accesses a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.fn=f.id AND a.__start>=v.__start AND a.__end<=v.__end) OR wrapper.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.id=c.id WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=v.__start AND n.__end<=v.__end) THEN CASE WHEN wrapper.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PLP-004' ELSE 'PLP-003' END
        WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tainted_locals t JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=t.name AND n.__start>t.since WHERE t.__path=f.__path AND t.fn=f.id AND n.__start>=v.__start AND n.__end<=v.__end) THEN 'PLP-005'
        WHEN v.kind NOT IN ('call','subscript') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM global_uses g WHERE g.__path=f.__path AND g.fn=f.id AND g.__start>=v.__start AND g.__end<=v.__end) THEN 'PLP-008' END issue,
        CASE WHEN opaque.id IS NOT NULL THEN opaque.payload_field ELSE coalesce(dynamic.detail,'return') END detail,allowed.id IS NOT NULL allowed
        FROM active_functions f JOIN returns r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.__start>=f.body_start AND r.__end<=f.body_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=r.__path AND v.id=r.value LEFT JOIN passthrough pass ON pass.__path=v.__path AND pass.id=v.id
        LEFT JOIN calls allowed ON allowed.__path=r.__path AND allowed.id=coalesce(pass.value,v.id) AND allowed.callee_kind='identifier' AND allowed.callee IN ('build_internal_permission_query_request','enqueue_lazy_plan_intent','next_lazy_plan_ref','publish_pending_lazy_ref','publish_pending_lazy_ref_for_txn') LEFT JOIN opaque_values opaque ON opaque.__path=r.__path AND opaque.id=coalesce(pass.value,v.id) LEFT JOIN dynamic_accesses dynamic ON dynamic.__path=r.__path AND dynamic.fn=f.id AND dynamic.id=v.id LEFT JOIN return_contracts contract ON contract.__path=f.__path AND contract.id=f.id LEFT JOIN runtime_calls runtime ON runtime.__path=v.__path AND runtime.id=coalesce(pass.value,v.id) LEFT JOIN calls wrapper ON wrapper.__path=v.__path AND wrapper.id=v.id AND wrapper.callee IN ('of','from_value','resolved') AND rx_matches(wrapper.full_callee,'^(?:LazyResult|LazySeq)\.'))

stages.name: call_events
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","issue","detail","allowed" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,
        CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('build_internal_permission_query_request','enqueue_lazy_plan_intent','next_lazy_plan_ref','publish_pending_lazy_ref','publish_pending_lazy_ref_for_txn') THEN NULL WHEN dynamic.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PLP-002' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k JOIN global_uses g ON g.__path=k.__path AND g.fn=f.id AND g.__start>=k.__start AND g.__end<=k.__end WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('_base_txn','_conn','_cursor','_read_txn','_schema_txn','_session','_sql_conn','_transaction','_tx','_txn','_write_txn','conn','connection','context','cursor','session','tx','txn')) THEN 'PLP-008' WHEN global.name IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contextvars ctx WHERE ctx.__path=c.__path AND ctx.name=global.name) THEN 'PLP-008' WHEN NOT (global.managed AND '.'||c.callee IN ('.get','.get_for_key','.get_or_compute','.get_with_generation','.set','.set_for_key','.token_for')) AND NOT (c.__path='l1000_cache/schema_generation.py' AND global.name='_callback_registry' AND c.callee IN ('contains','register','version')) THEN 'PLP-009' END END issue,
        coalesce(dynamic.detail,global.name||'.'||c.callee,'call') detail,(c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('build_internal_permission_query_request','enqueue_lazy_plan_intent','next_lazy_plan_ref','publish_pending_lazy_ref','publish_pending_lazy_ref_for_txn')) OR dynamic.id IS NOT NULL OR global.name IS NOT NULL allowed
        FROM active_functions f JOIN calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>=f.body_start AND c.__end<=f.body_end LEFT JOIN dynamic_accesses dynamic ON dynamic.__path=c.__path AND dynamic.fn=f.id AND dynamic.id=c.id LEFT JOIN global_receivers global ON global.__path=c.__path AND global.fn=f.id AND global.id=c.receiver)

stages.name: attribute_events
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","issue","detail",NULL AS "allowed" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,a.id,a.__start,a.__end,'PLP-001' issue,a.attr detail,0 allowed FROM active_functions f JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.__end<=f.body_end WHERE a.attr IN ('_base_txn','_conn','_cursor','_read_txn','_schema_txn','_session','_sql_conn','_transaction','_tx','_txn','_write_txn') AND NOT (f.surface AND a.object_text='self' AND a.attr IN ('_base_txn','_plan','_plan_mixin','_txn')) AND (f.strict OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM protected_accesses p WHERE p.__path=a.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.id=a.id AND NOT p.through_call)))

stages.name: global_events
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","issue","detail",NULL AS "allowed" FROM (SELECT g.__path,g.fn,g.id,g.__start,g.__end,'PLP-009' issue,g.name detail,0 allowed FROM global_uses g WHERE g.mutable UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,g.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,'PLP-009',g.name||'[]',0 FROM nodes n JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=n.__path AND value.parent=n.id AND value.ordinal=0 JOIN global_receivers g ON g.__path=value.__path AND g.id=value.id WHERE n.kind='subscript')

stages.name: events
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","issue","detail",NULL AS "allowed" FROM (SELECT * FROM return_events WHERE issue IS NOT NULL OR allowed UNION ALL SELECT * FROM call_events WHERE issue IS NOT NULL OR allowed UNION ALL SELECT * FROM attribute_events UNION ALL SELECT * FROM global_events)

stages.name: visible_events
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","issue","detail",NULL AS "allowed","qualname" FROM (SELECT e.*,f.qualname FROM events e JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=e.__path AND f.id=e.fn WHERE e.issue IS NOT NULL AND (f.color='pure' OR e.issue IN ('PLP-001','PLP-002','PLP-003','PLP-004','PLP-005')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events ancestor WHERE ancestor.__path=e.__path AND ancestor.fn=e.fn AND ancestor.id!=e.id AND ancestor.__start<=e.__start AND ancestor.__end>=e.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls cast_call JOIN arguments type ON type.__path=cast_call.__path AND type.call=cast_call.id AND type.position=0 WHERE cast_call.__path=e.__path AND cast_call.callee_kind='identifier' AND cast_call.callee='cast' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=cast_call.__path AND a.call=cast_call.id)=2 AND type.__start<=e.__start AND type.__end>=e.__end))

stages.name: export_names
stages.query: SELECT "__path","module","name","target_module","target_name" FROM (SELECT m.__path,m.module,coalesce(x.alias_source,x.name_source,x.text) name,n.module_name_source target_module,coalesce(x.name_source,x.text) target_name FROM file_modules m JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.kind='import_from_statement' JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent AND parent.kind='module' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id AND x.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND x.id IS NOT n.module_name_id UNION ALL SELECT m.__path,m.module,f.name,NULL,NULL FROM file_modules m JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=m.__path AND f.lexical_parent IS NULL)

stages.name: exported_functions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","__start","__end","qualname" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE exported(module,name) AS (
        SELECT e.module,e.name FROM export_names e WHERE e.__path GLOB 'data_layer/*.py' AND NOT rx_matches(substr(e.__path,12),'/') AND e.name NOT GLOB '_*' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM module_bindings b WHERE b.__path=e.__path AND b.name='__all__') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM module_bindings b JOIN strings s ON s.__path=b.__path AND s.__start>=b.right_start AND s.__end<=b.right_end WHERE b.__path=e.__path AND b.name='__all__' AND s.value=e.name))
        UNION SELECT e.target_module,e.target_name FROM exported old JOIN export_names e ON e.module=old.module AND e.name=old.name WHERE e.target_module IS NOT NULL)
        SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.id,f.__start,f.__end,f.qualname FROM exported e JOIN file_modules m ON m.module=e.module JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=m.__path AND f.name=e.name AND f.lexical_parent IS NULL WHERE f.name GLOB '*_lazy' AND f.name NOT GLOB '_*' AND NOT f.explicit AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM primary_paths) OR f.__path IN (SELECT path FROM primary_paths)))

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","issue","identity","detail","qualname","fn","node" FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,issue,fn||':'||id identity,detail,qualname,fn,id node FROM visible_events UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,'PLP-006',f.id||':contract','contract',f.qualname,f.id,f.id FROM active_functions f JOIN return_contracts c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=f.id WHERE f.color='pure' UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'PLP-007',id||':export','export',qualname,id,id FROM exported_functions)

cases.scan_source:
WITH global_context AS (
      SELECT d.__path,d.identity,g.name,k.name sink,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY d.__path,d.identity ORDER BY g.__start,k.keyword_start) chosen
      FROM diagnostics d JOIN global_uses g ON g.__path=d.__path AND g.fn=d.fn AND g.__start>=d.__start AND g.__end<=d.__end
      LEFT JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=d.__path AND k.call=d.node AND g.__start>=k.__start AND g.__end<=k.__end)
      SELECT d.__path path,d.__start start_byte,d.__end end_byte,d.issue,d.identity,d.qualname,
      CASE d.issue
        WHEN 'PLP-001' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not access runtime attribute '||quote(d.detail)
        WHEN 'PLP-002' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not dynamically access runtime attribute '||quote(d.detail)
        WHEN 'PLP-003' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not return runtime-bound handles or containers'
        WHEN 'PLP-004' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not return resolved lazy wrappers containing runtime-bound state'
        WHEN 'PLP-005' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not return locals derived from runtime-bound state'
        WHEN 'PLP-006' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not declare runtime-handle return types'
        WHEN 'PLP-007' THEN 'exported public *_lazy functions must be decorated with @pure_lazy'
        WHEN 'PLP-008' THEN CASE WHEN n.kind='return_statement' THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not return module-level runtime state '||quote(context.name)
          WHEN context.sink IS NOT NULL THEN 'pure-lazy functions must not pass module-level runtime state '||quote(context.name)||' into runtime sink '||quote(context.sink)
          ELSE 'pure-lazy functions must not read ambient module-level runtime state '||quote(context.name) END
